shortDescription: Installs FTD pkg image on the firewall

options.name: console_ip
options.description: IP address of a terminal server. Used to set up an SSH connection with device's console port through the terminal server.

options.name: console_password
options.description: Password to login on a terminal server.

options.name: console_port
options.description: Device's port on a terminal server.

options.name: console_username
options.description: Username to login on a terminal server.

options.name: device_gateway
options.description: Device gateway of management interface. If not specified and connection is 'httpapi`, the module tries to fetch the existing value via REST API. For 'local' connection type, this parameter is mandatory.

options.name: device_hostname
options.description: Hostname of the device as appears in the prompt (e.g., 'firepower-5516').

options.name: device_ip
options.description: Device IP address of management interface. If not specified and connection is 'httpapi`, the module tries to fetch the existing value via REST API. For 'local' connection type, this parameter is mandatory.

options.name: device_model
options.description: Platform model of the device (e.g., 'Cisco ASA5506-X Threat Defense'). If not specified and connection is 'httpapi`, the module tries to fetch the device model via REST API. For 'local' connection type, this parameter is mandatory.

options.name: device_netmask
options.description: Device netmask of management interface. If not specified and connection is 'httpapi`, the module tries to fetch the existing value via REST API. For 'local' connection type, this parameter is mandatory.

options.name: device_new_password
options.description: New device password to set after image installation. If not specified, current password from `device_password` property is reused. Not applicable for ASA5500-X series devices.

options.name: device_password
options.description: Password to login on the device.

options.name: device_sudo_password
options.description: Root password for the device. If not specified, `device_password` is used.

options.name: device_username
options.description: Username to login on the device. Defaulted to 'admin' if not specified.

options.name: dns_server
options.description: DNS IP address of management interface. If not specified and connection is 'httpapi`, the module tries to fetch the existing value via REST API. For 'local' connection type, this parameter is mandatory.

options.name: force_install
options.description: Forces the FTD image to be installed even when the same version is already installed on the firewall. By default, the module stops execution when the target version is installed in the device.

options.name: image_file_location
options.description: Path to the FTD pkg image on the server to be downloaded. FTP, SCP, SFTP, TFTP, or HTTP protocols are usually supported, but may depend on the device model.

options.name: image_version
options.description: Version of FTD image to be installed. Helps to compare target and current FTD versions to prevent unnecessary reinstalls.

options.name: rommon_file_location
options.description: Path to the boot (ROMMON) image on TFTP server. Only TFTP is supported.

options.name: search_domains
options.description: Search domains delimited by comma. Defaulted to 'cisco.com' if not specified.
